entities.summary:
Tivadar Millner 
was a Hungarian chemical engineer, educator, and inventor who developed tungsten lamps. Working at Tungsram, Millner, along with Pál Túry,
co-developed large-crystal tungsten technology for the production of more reliable and longer-lasting coiled filament lamps.
